name: RoboForm
description_en:
RoboForm combines password storage, login filling and structured form filling across supported clients. Its current plans distinguish a single-device Free account from Premium synchronization, web access and additional sharing/recovery features. Business administration is a separate plan scope.

A pilot should verify a real form, a login and a recovery method on the intended device. Passwordless unlock, second-factor authentication and recovery of an encrypted vault solve different problems; a feature name alone does not establish that all three work after a device is lost.
description_zh:
RoboForm 在受支持客户端结合密码存储、登录填充及结构化表单填充。当前套餐区分单设备 Free 与包含同步、网页访问及更多共享／恢复功能的 Premium，商业管理另有套餐范围。

试点应在目标设备核对真实表单、登录及恢复方法。无密码解锁、第二因素认证和加密保险库恢复解决不同问题，不能凭功能名称认定丢失设备后全部仍可用。

sections.title_en: Capture a login and inspect the fill target
sections.title_zh: 保存登录并检查填充目标
sections.en:
The homepage describes automatically capturing generated passwords, one-click logins, form filling and importing from browsers, other managers or CSV. It lists passkeys and a built-in TOTP authenticator, alongside tools for compromised passwords. These are documented capabilities rather than measured protection or speed gains.

For an evaluation, import a disposable record with a URL and test it on the correct domain, then inspect a multi-field address form before submission. Verify custom fields and multiple accounts for the same site separately. A breach alert is a signal to investigate and change the external credential, not automatic proof that an attacker has been removed.
sections.zh:
首页描述自动捕获生成密码、一键登录、表单填充，以及从浏览器、其他管理器或 CSV 导入；另列 passkey、内置 TOTP 及泄露密码工具。这些是文档能力，不是实测防护或速度收益。

评估可导入带网址的可丢弃记录，在正确域名测试，再在提交前检查多字段地址表单。自定义字段、同站多账户需分别核对。泄露提醒是调查及更改外部凭据的信号，不能自动证明攻击者已被清除。

sections.title_zh: 提前启用依赖设备的恢复
sections.en:
The Android recovery guide says a biometric-capable device may restore a forgotten master password only after Account Recovery is enabled in the app’s Security settings; it prompts for biometrics if needed. This is a conditional device workflow, not an unconditional server password reset. Do not assume it remains available after losing the enrolled device.

The pricing page describes local-only mode as keeping data and backups on the device without server sync. That increases the importance of a separately tested backup plan. This research did not enable recovery, test a lost-device scenario, audit encryption or inspect software license terms.
sections.zh:
Android 恢复指南说明，具备生物识别的设备需事先在应用安全设置启用 Account Recovery，才可能恢复遗忘的主密码；必要时会要求启用生物识别。这是有条件的设备流程，不是无条件服务器密码重置，不能假设丢失已登记设备后仍可用。

价格页将仅本地模式描述为数据和备份保存在设备、不与服务器同步，因此更需单独验证备份方案。本文未启用恢复、测试丢设备、审计加密或检查软件许可条款。

sections.title_en: Renewal prices are readable; promotions are not
sections.title_zh: 可读续费价不等于促销首年价
sections.en:
The current page shows Premium renewing at USD 29.88/year and Family at USD 47.75/year for up to five Premium accounts. First-year sale amounts appear as unresolved placeholders, so no introductory price is asserted. The page advertises a 30-day money-back guarantee; that is different from permanent free usage.

Free provides unlimited passwords on one device. The homepage places all-device access, web access, secure shared folders, emergency access and local-only mode under Premium. Flat text in a comparison can omit exclusion icons, so use those explicit plan descriptions rather than treating every listed feature as included in Free. Business SSO, SCIM and policy administration require a separate commercial check.
sections.zh:
当前页显示 Premium 续费每年 29.88 美元，Family 最多五个 Premium 账户每年 47.75 美元。首年促销金额是未解析占位符，因此本文不声明首年优惠价。页面宣传 30 天退款保证，与永久免费使用不同。

Free 可在一台设备保存不限密码。首页将跨设备、网页访问、安全共享文件夹、紧急访问及仅本地模式列入 Premium。比较表纯文本可能丢失排除图标，应依据明确套餐说明，不能将每个列出的功能都算入 Free。商业 SSO、SCIM 及策略管理需另查合同。
